record.question: The punishment for alteration of denatured alcohol etc as per section 46 is _______.
options: for a term of not less than six months which may extend to five years and with fine of not less than five thousand rupees which may extend to ten thousand rupees.
for a term of not less than six months which may extend to two years and with fine of not less than five thousand rupees which may extend to ten thousand rupees.
for a term of not less than six months which may extend to 10 years and with fine of not less than five thousand rupees which may extend to ten thousand rupees.
for a term of not less than six months which may extend to one year and with fine of not less than five thousand rupees which may extend to ten thousand rupees.
record.explanation: Alteration of denatured alcohol is punishable with six months to two years imprisonment.
